purpose: Confirm physical component routes for high-confidence mask/headgear candidates and separate identity-bearing mask geometry from protective/environmental face equipment before source-appearance pairing.

head_evidence.part_name: Minifig Head The Flash, Balaclava, Light Nougat Face, Orange Eyebrows, Cheek Lines, Smiling / Angry Print

headgear_evidence.part_name: Mask with Lightning Bolt Wings, Yellow Print (The Flash)

records.training_note: The underlying printed head carries facial/balaclava state while the separate molded mask supplies the Flash's lightning-wing silhouette; this is a true identity-bearing mask route.

head_evidence.part_name: Minifig Head Aquanaut, Glasses with Green Lenses, Brown Hair Print [Blocked Open Stud]

records.training_note: The separate face element is functional dive equipment layered over a human head and helmet. Keep it as a face-equipment route, but do not use it as an identity-mask/cowl training example.

head_evidence.part_name: Minifig Head Dash, Open Mouth, Stubble, Thin Eyes and Headset Print

records.training_note: This is a layered protective-equipment route rather than an identity mask: ordinary decorated human head, helmet, then detachable diving visor/mask.

head_evidence.part_name: Minifig Head Hockey Player, Raised Eyebrows, Angry Open Mouth, White Pupils Print [Blocked Open Stud]

records.training_note: Catalog wording contains 'mask', but the component is a detachable sports faceguard paired with a helmet. It should not be merged into superhero/character identity-mask examples.

head_evidence.part_name: Minifig Head Football Player, Eyebrows, Cheek Lines and Black Underlined Eyes Print

records.training_note: The same helmet/faceguard geometry used in the sports inventory is protective equipment, not identity-bearing mask geometry. Preserve the physical route while excluding it from identity-mask supervision.

systemic_findings: Keyword 'mask' is overloaded across identity masks, diving visors, and sports faceguards; semantic function must be modeled separately from component topology.
Physical component-route confirmation can be high confidence before exact source-appearance pairing, but it must not silently become source-to-LEGO translation supervision.
Protective equipment should remain available for geometry/component training while being excluded from character-identity mask examples.
